_comment: Optional human-reviewed overrides keyed by player name. See README.md for fields.

Jordyn Tyson.reason: Sleeper and ESPN identify the hamstring injury, while FantasyPros and DraftKings Network independently carry the reported two-month timeline. Mapping the possible mid-October return to New Orleans' schedule produces a 5-6 regular-season fantasy-week range.

sources.note: Reports an expected absence of about two months and a mid-October return window.
Reports the two-month timeline and estimates at least five missed games.

Jordan James.reason: A rib fracture remains without a firm return timetable. The 49ers reported him sidelined on August 18, while FantasyPros independently reported that he will miss time; a 0-1 regular-season week range preserves the unresolved Week 1 uncertainty.

sources.note: The team listed Jordan James as sidelined with a rib injury.
